title: Electing the Post-9/11 GI Bill in Place of a Montgomery GI Bill Chapter - Election Desk Reference
content:
**Desk reference — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education): the irrevocable election of the Post-9/11 GI Bill in place of Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) or Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606).**

**The rule.** A student who elects the Post-9/11 GI Bill in place of Chapter 30 or Chapter 1606 relinquishes that chapter on the day of the election and is credited Post-9/11 entitlement measured in days of a 30-day month.

**Condition on the entitlement credited.** The Post-9/11 entitlement credited on an election is not fixed until the relinquished chapter's entitlement ledger carries a restoration entry for every amended certification whose dropped days were charged. In other words, while any such amended certification still has no restoration entry on that ledger, the entitlement to be credited is not yet fixed.

**Business effect of the election.** The election marks the chapter relinquished as of today and, in the same election, opens the student's Post-9/11 GI Bill benefit at the benefit level stated, credited with the Post-9/11 entitlement days stated, payable to the same payment method and account as the relinquished chapter and with no delimiting date. The relinquished chapter can never be used again. The student sees the relinquished chapter and the new Post-9/11 benefit on their education benefits straight away.

### How the election is made

The election is the student's own: the tool `elect_post911_in_place_of_chapter_2e090e13` belongs to the student. The representative unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `edu_benefit_id` | The reference number of the education benefit being relinquished, as shown on the student's education benefits | Identifier |
| `post911_variant_name` | The Post-9/11 GI Bill benefit level opened by the election | Exactly one of the official tier names below |
| `post911_entitlement_days` | The Post-9/11 entitlement credited on the election | Whole number of days, one month counting as 30 days |

Values of `post911_variant_name`:
- Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606), Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) and Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30) — never apply to an election, since none is a Post-9/11 level;
- Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 60% Benefit Level — aggregate post-9/11 active service of 6 to less than 18 months;
- Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 70% Benefit Level — 18 to less than 24 months;
- Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 80% Benefit Level — 24 to less than 30 months;
- Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 90% Benefit Level — 30 to less than 36 months;
- Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) - 100% Benefit Level — 36 months or more, or a Purple Heart, or 30 continuous days with a service-connected disability discharge.

### Receipt

On success the receipt returns `status` "elected", `relinquished_benefit_id` (the chapter given up), `relinquished_on` (the YYYY-MM-DD date of the election), `post911_benefit_id` (the reference number of the new Post-9/11 benefit), `post911_variant_name` and `post911_entitlement_days`. The tool defines no error receipt.
